name: WP Spotlight – User Search, Post search, Media search, Quick updates
author: Jewel Theme

sections.description:
WP Spotlight is a game-changing WordPress search plugin that simplifies and accelerates your workflow.

Inspired by Mac’s Spotlight, this dashboard navigation plugin allows you to search, manage, and edit everything in your WordPress admin from a single search bar.

Whether you’re updating a theme, managing users, or searching for posts, updating plugins or the WordPress core, WP Spotlight ensures you get things done faster.

It’s designed for both WordPress beginners and power users, offering seamless integration and unparalleled productivity.

Why Choose WP Spotlight?

WordPress users often struggle with scattered menus and slow navigation. WP Spotlight solves this problem by providing an intuitive live search plugin that integrates directly into your WordPress dashboard. Quickly locate posts, users, plugins, or themes with minimal effort.

  • Perform plugin updates and manage themes directly from the search bar.

  • Search for and manage comments content without navigating away.

  • Manage multisite settings and switch between subsites from one search bar.

  • Designed for professionals managing multiple websites, whether as an admin, developer, or agency.

  • Builder supported: Elementor, Gutenberg, Bricks. (More upcoming)

WP Spotlight is more than just a search bar—it’s your productivity companion.

Features

Seamless Dashboard Navigation

Effortlessly navigate your WordPress dashboard with real-time search results. WP Spotlight allows you to find and access any admin page, plugin, theme, or post with just a few keystrokes, making it the ultimate dashboard search tool for WordPress.

Frontend Search

WP Spotlight search is also accessible on the frontend which means you can search and manage any user, plugin, theme, media and update from the frontend without needing to navigate to the dashboard.

Advanced Live Search for WordPress

WP Spotlight delivers instant search results for everything from posts to comments content. With its advanced algorithms, it’s the most reliable live search plugin for WordPress, helping you locate exactly what you need without delays.

Post Content Search and Management

Search for and manage posts with unparalleled efficiency. Whether you’re using Gutenberg, Bricks, Elementor, WP Spotlight integrates seamlessly to provide direct editing options, making it the best tool for post search and management.

Comprehensive Plugin Management

Find, install, activate, deactivate, delete and update plugins without leaving your dashboard. With WP Spotlight, plugin management is as simple as typing a query, making it an indispensable plugin management tool.

User Search and Management

Quickly locate and manage users in your WordPress site. Send password reset links, update user roles (upcoming), and edit profiles—all from the convenience of the search bar. This makes WP Spotlight a powerful user search plugin for administrators.

Theme Search and Updates

Search for, install, download, upload, and activate themes directly into the search bar. WP Spotlight also supports quick theme updates, allowing you to keep your site up-to-date with minimal effort.

Media File Management

Search, edit, and download media files instantly. Also handle media uploads directly from search. WP Spotlight streamlines your media library operations, making it an essential media search plugin for WordPress users.

Multisite Navigation and Management

Managing a WordPress multisite network? WP Spotlight’s multisite navigation lets you switch between sites instantly. With this feature, network administrators can seamlessly search for specific sites in their network, perform actions like plugin updates or content editing across multiple sites, and handle complex tasks efficiently.

Customizable Key Binds

WP Spotlight lets you assign shortcuts to any search type or action, creating a personalized, efficient search experience that adapts to your workflow. This feature includes the ability to set and modify key binds for each WP Spotlight search functionality, enabling tailored workflows and boosting productivity by allowing you to jump directly to common actions or search types with a single keystroke.

Comment Management

Handle comments directly from the search bar. Approve, unapprove, reply, edit, mark as spam, trash, restore, or delete comments with ease. It’s a powerful feature for managing comments content efficiently.

Quick Updates Manager

Manage all your WordPress updates—plugins, themes, and core updates—in one place. WP Spotlight simplifies the update process, helping you save time and maintain site security. Need a quick plugin update? Do it from anywhere on your website. Dashboard or the frontend!

Dark Mode Switcher

Switch between dark and light modes effortlessly, powered by Adminify’s advanced Dark Mode script. This feature enhances your visual experience while working in the WordPress admin.

Role-Based Access Management (Upcoming)

Control what users can search for based on their roles. This feature will allow admins to define access levels, ensuring secure and customized user experiences.

Admin Role Switcher (Upcoming)

Switch user roles directly from search for streamlined administration, testing, and support.

WooCommerce Order Search (Upcoming)

Quickly find and manage WooCommerce orders, making WP Spotlight the ideal tool for eCommerce site owners needing WooCommerce search on their stores.

Fuzzy Search Implementation

Get accurate results even with typos. This feature will make WP Spotlight even more powerful as a live search plugin.

AI Search History (Upcoming)

Automatically display frequently accessed items at the top of search results. This AI-powered feature will revolutionize how you interact with your WordPress site.

Live Demo | Docs | Upgrade Pro | Video Tutorials

Pro Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced functionality: Post Content Search: Search and manage post content with full control over page builder integrations (Divi, Oxygen, Bricks).

  • Comment Management: Approve, edit, reply, or delete comments
    from one place.

  • Media Search: Edit and download media files directly using the
    image search feature from the search bar.

  • Quick Updates Manager: Update plugins and themes in bulk or
    individually with just a few clicks. Complete update control.

  • WordPress Core Updates: Update the WordPress core from search in
    one click.

  • User Management: Send password reset links and edit user roles.

  • Front end access: Access search on both the back and front end.

  • Dark Mode: Toggle dark/light mode on the dashboard directly from search in one keystroke.

Who Should Use WP Spotlight?

  • Website Administrators: Simplify site management with tools for user search, theme updates, and more.

  • Content Creators: Quickly locate and manage posts, comments, and
    media files without hassle.

  • Developers: Use advanced tools for managing plugins, themes, and
    users across multiple sites.

  • eCommerce Owners: Manage WooCommerce orders and products
    effortlessly (feature coming soon).

Other Use Cases

WP Spotlight is the best WordPress search plugin for:

1) Dashboard Search: Navigate your admin dashboard like a pro.

2) Live Search for WordPress: Instant results for posts, plugins, and themes.

3) Fast Media Upload: Upload media files directly into search.

4) Quick Post Search: Access your content with ease and speed, whether it’s posts or custom post types.

5) User Search: Manage WordPress users with an efficient search process.

6) Quick Update Tool: Handle theme updates directly from the search bar.

7) Update From Frontend: Handle all updates from frontend as well as dashboard.

8) Quick Updates Manager: Keep your plugins and themes up-to-date.

Upcoming Features

We are constantly working to make WP Spotlight the most powerful admin search tool. Here’s what’s coming:

1) Fuzzy Search Implementation: Get results even with typos.

2) WooCommerce Order Search: Manage orders as easily as you manage posts.

3) AI Search History: Show most-visited searches at the top.

4) Role-Based Access Management: Control what users can search for based on roles.

5) Admin Bar Button: Access WP Spotlight faster with a floating button.

Explore More Plugins

WP Adminify:

Enhance your admin dashboard with advanced customization tools, including a dark mode, menu editor, and custom widgets.

Admin Bar Editor:

Take full control of your admin bar. Add, remove, or rearrange items to streamline your workflow.

Loginfy:

Create stunning, branded login pages effortlessly.

RoleMaster Suite:

Fine-tune user roles and capabilities with this robust user management tool.

Activity Logs:

Track user activity to maintain security and transparency on your site.

Header & Footer Scripts:

Easily add scripts to your site’s header or footer without touching the code. This addon simplifies the process of integrating tracking codes, custom styles, or scripts into your WordPress site.

Admin Columns Editor:

Customize the admin columns displayed in your dashboard with the Admin Columns Editor. This addon allows you to rearrange, remove, or add columns, ensuring that your Admin Columns show the most relevant information for your workflow.

Google Pagespeed:

Optimize site performance directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Sidebar Generator:

Create custom sidebars for different pages and post types.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Downloaded “spotlight.zip” Folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and unzip on your cpanel.
  2. UNZIP “spotlight.zip” folder and Upload spotlight on “wp-content/plugins/” folder via FTP or Copy and Paste on your Local Computer.
sections.faq:
Is WP Spotlight compatible with WordPress multisite?

Yes. WP Spotlight is multisite compatible. We’ve tested this plugin in multisite and configured it properly for WP multisite.

Is WP Spotlight translation ready?

Yes. It’s a WPML ready plugin. You can change all strings in your language.

Is it RTL ready plugin?

Yes. WP Spotlight is suitable for RTL users.

Is WP Spotlight keyboard accessible?

Yes. WP Spotlight is completely keyboard accessible with customizable keyboard shortcuts by up to 4 key combinations.

How many builders does WP Spotlight support?

Currently, WP Spotlight has support for ELementor, Bricks, Gutenberg but we are working on introducing new builder support such as Bricks, Divi, Oxygen and more.

Does it affect website page speed?

No. As it will not load any extra script in your front end, your page speed will not affect by this plugin.

Is there any way to test Premium Features without Purchasing WP Adminify?

Yes, you can try our WP Spotlight live demo to play with all features.

How can I get faster Support?

To get faster support, we recommend you to create a support topic in our WP Spotlight Forum. Our support team will check your question and get back to you with a solution or alternative.
